Q1: What should this issue deliver, given that the failure comes from the test itself on ubuntu-26.04 and several open PRs already target the same test?
Choices:
A) No code change. Treat this issue as a duplicate of the open fix (#9345, whose title names the closed-reader test, and/or #9246). Once that fix merges into `main`, update `ai/issue-9326` from `main` and re-run CI. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Land a test-only fix in a new PR against `main`. Change the reader in `test_closed_reader_does_not_rerun_a_successful_command` so it really closes without reading everything, keep the assertion that the status is non-zero and the command runs once, and leave `scripts/gh_helpers.sh` alone. This may conflict with #9264, #9267 and #9345, which edit the same file.
C) Add a fix for this test to PR #9335's branch (`ai/issue-9326`) so that PR goes green on its own. This goes against the issue's advice not to work around the failure on that PR, and it will conflict when #9345 or #9246 merges.
